item.title: U.S. Military Inundated with Protests over Release of Anti-Communist POWs... Rhee Syngman's One Line That Protected Baek Seon-yeop (반공 포로 석방에 미군 항의 빗발… 백선엽을 지킨 이승만의 한 마디)
item.description:
U.S. Military Inundated with Protests over Release of Anti-Communist POWs... Rhee Syngman's One Line That Protected Baek Seon-yeop (반공 포로 석방에 미군 항의 빗발… 백선엽을 지킨 이승만의 한 마디)

The "surprise release of anti-communist prisoners of war" that stunned the world in an instant was carried out with remarkable boldness and speed. Baek Seon-yeop was not oblivious to such a move, but he was in a position where it was difficult to intervene rashly. The president had his own duties as president, and as the Chief of Staff of the Republic of Korea Army leading the military, the Chief of Staff had his own distinct role. (세계를 일거에 경악하게 한 ‘반공 포로 전격 석방’은 그야말로 대담하며 신속하게 이뤄졌다. 백선엽은 그런 움직임에 둔감하지 않았으나, 함부로 개입하기도 어려운 입장이었다. 대통령은 대통령으로서 할 일이 있었고, 군을 이끄는 한국 육군참모총장으로서는 총장의 역할이 따로 있었다.)

President Rhee Syngman was a strong and towering figure who never yielded an inch in the game of brinkmanship with the United States. Rather, he was fully revealing his fierce side as a gambler who could overturn the entire board against the mighty America. His bluster about "the ROK military's unilateral advance north and unification" often threw the United States into deep embarrassment. Baek Seon-yeop was in a position where he had to follow the president's assertions, but he could not step forward recklessly either. (이승만 대통령은 미국과의 기세 싸움에서 전혀 밀리지 않는 강인하고 거대한 인물이었다. 아니, 어쩌면 강대한 미국을 상대로 판을 한꺼번에 뒤집어 버리는 승부사로서 맹렬한 면모를 다 드러내고 있었다. 그가 주장하는 ‘한국군 단독 북진과 통일’이라는 으름장은 그런 미국을 자주 곤혹감에 몰아넣기도 했다. 백선엽은 그런 대통령의 주장을 따라야 하는 입장이었으나, 함부로 나설 수도 없었다.)

At the time, it was wartime. The war on the Korean Peninsula at that time could not escape American influence. The person forming the sharpest point of contact in negotiations with the U.S. military was none other than Baek Seon-yeop. The U.S. command had established its closest cooperative relationship with Baek Seon-yeop, the Korean commander they had trusted and relied on since the outbreak of the Korean War, and Baek Seon-yeop happened to hold the position of Chief of Staff of the ROK Army at that very moment. (당시는 전시(戰時)였다. 한반도의 그때 전쟁은 미국의 영향력을 벗어날 수 없었다. 그런 미군과의 교섭에 가장 첨예한 접점을 형성하고 있던 인물이 바로 백선엽이었다. 미군 지휘부는 6·25전쟁 발발 후 믿고 의지했던 백선엽이라는 한국 지휘관과 가장 두터운 협력 관계를 맺은 상태였고, 백선엽은 마침 그 시점에 대한민국 육군참모총장이라는 자리에 있었다.)

Therefore, Baek Seon-yeop was absolutely bound to obey the orders of the president as commander-in-chief, yet he could not arbitrarily step outside the framework of negotiating with and maintaining cooperation with the U.S. military. President Rhee was well aware of this, and accordingly, he excluded Baek Seon-yeop from the "release of anti-communist POWs" that would greatly provoke the United States. (따라서 백선엽은 통수권자인 대통령의 명령에는 절대적으로 따라야 하지만, 미군과의 교섭과 협력 유지라는 틀을 함부로 벗어날 수 없었다. 이 대통령도 그 점을 잘 알았고, 그에 따라 미국을 크게 자극할 ‘반공 포로 석방’에서 백선엽을 제외했던 것이다.)

The event unfolded on the evening of June 18. As introduced earlier, President Rhee Syngman had established the "Provost Marshal General's Headquarters" commanded by General Won Yong-deok, and once darkness fell on the 18th, personnel from the headquarters went around the POW camps, cutting electric wires and barbed wire to help anti-communist prisoners escape. They also meticulously guided them by preparing civilian clothes to change into at various government offices after the escape. (6월 18일 저녁에 일은 벌어지고 말았다. 앞서 소개한 대로 이승만 대통령은 원용덕 장군이 지휘하는 ‘헌병 총사령부’를 만들었고, 18일 어둠이 깔리자 총사령부의 인원들은 포로 수용소를 돌며 전기선과 철조망을 끊어 반공 포로들이 탈출할 수 있도록 도왔다. 각급 관공서에는 탈출 뒤 갈아입을 복장 등을 준비해 치밀하게 그들을 이끌기도 했다.)

It was a shocking measure that could have undone all the progress of the armistice talks that had continued up to that point. The voices of "astonishment" that learned of the news only later came immediately. Phone calls from the top U.S. military leadership rang directly at the official residence of Chief of Staff Baek Seon-yeop at the Daegu Army Headquarters. (그때까지 이어지던 휴전회담의 모든 성과가 수포로 돌아갈 수도 있는 충격적인 조치였다. 그 소식을 나중에야 안 ‘경악’의 목소리는 바로 전해졌다. 미군 수뇌부에서 걸려온 전화가 대구 육군본부 백선엽 참모총장 관사에 바로 울렸다.)

The first to call was Major General Ryan, commander of the U.S. Military Advisory Group stationed in Korea supporting the Korean military. Then the phone rang again, it was said. It was a call from Maxwell Taylor, commander of the U.S. Eighth Army. The third call came from Mark Clark, commander-in-chief of the United Nations Command in Tokyo. (가장 먼저 전화를 건 사람은 한국에 주둔하며 한국군을 지원하던 미 군사고문단장 라이언 소장이었다. 바로 이어서 전화가 또 울렸다고 했다. 맥스웰 테일러 미8군 사령관의 전화였다. 세 번째 전화는 마크 클라크 도쿄 주재 유엔군 총사령관에게서 걸려왔다.)

General Baek Seon-yeop recalled in his memoirs: "The phone kept ringing at dawn. All the calls were from the top U.S. military leadership, and every one of them, shocked, was demanding to know the details of what had happened." According to his recollections, all three men showed extreme agitation, asking, "General Baek, what on earth has happened?" (백선엽 장군은 생전 회고에서 “새벽에 전화기가 계속 울렸다. 모두 미군 수뇌부의 전화였고, 한결같이 놀라서 사건의 경위부터 따져 묻는 내용이었다”고 술회했다. 그의 회고에 따르면 세 사람 모두는 “백 장군, 도대체 어떻게 된 일이냐”면서 극도의 흥분 상태를 보였다고 했다.)

General Baek Seon-yeop reportedly felt deeply troubled while taking the calls. This was because the responsibility for the situation fell first and foremost on himself, as the one commanding the ROK military. If that became clear, the U.S. military's sense of betrayal would be directed at Baek Seon-yeop. The top U.S. commanders, caught in confusion, first asked about the circumstances, but in the future, they could raise disagreements over the overall support for the ROK military. It was a weighty and grave matter of great consequence. (백선엽 장군은 전화를 받으면서 곤혹감에 휩싸였다고 한다. 이 사태의 책임은 한국군을 통솔하는 자신에게 우선 있었기 때문이었다. 그 점이 확실해진다면, 미군의 배신감은 백선엽에게 쏠릴 참이었다. 미군 최고 지휘관들은 당혹감에 빠져 우선 사태의 경위를 물었지만 향후 그들은 한국군 지원 전반에 관해 이견을 제기할 수도 있었다. 무겁고 큰 중차대(重且大)의 사안이었다.)

President Rhee Syngman, through the Provost Marshal General's Headquarters, released approximately 25,000 anti-communist POWs in the first wave, and an additional 2,000 reportedly escaped the camps. From the perspectives of the UN side and the communist side, the sharply contested issue of anti-communist prisoners had suddenly tipped entirely toward "release," which was nothing short of what is commonly called a "catastrophe." World media reportedly covered the news extensively. The content, which could turn the armistice into nothing, was transmitted urgently around the globe, then coalesced into the fury and protests of the U.S. military command, aimed back at the ROK military and government. (이승만 대통령이 헌병 총사령부를 시켜 1차로 석방한 반공 포로는 2만5000명 정도였고, 추가로 2000명이 수용소를 빠져나왔다고 했다. 유엔 측과 공산 측의 입장에서 볼 때 첨예하게 대립했던 반공 성향의 포로 문제가 일거에 ‘석방’으로 기울고 말았으니 흔히 이야기하는 ‘파국(破局)’에 다름 아니었다. 세계의 언론들은 이 뉴스를 대대적으로 보도했다고 한다. 휴전이 물거품으로 변할지도 모를 이 내용은 긴급 타전 형식으로 세계 곳곳에 전해진 뒤 미군 지휘부의 분노와 항의로 뭉쳐져 다시 한국군과 정부를 향하고 있었다.)

Baek Seon-yeop could not remain silent in the face of the fury and protests of the top U.S. military leadership. Nor could he feign ignorance by saying, "The president did it, I know nothing." That was something he, as Chief of Staff leading the ROK military, could not say. Such an evasive, improvised answer to shirk responsibility was also not in keeping with Baek Seon-yeop's character. He reportedly fell into deep thought after receiving the calls that bordered on rebukes from the highest-ranking U.S. generals. (백선엽은 미군 수뇌부의 분노와 항의에 침묵만 할 수 없었다. 그렇다고 “대통령이 한 일이라 나는 모른다”고 잡아뗄 수도 없었다. 한국군을 이끄는 참모총장으로서는 해서는 안 될 말이었다. 책임을 회피하려는 그런 임기응변의 답변은 백선엽의 성향(性向)과도 맞지 않았다. 그는 미군 최고위 장성들의 힐난과도 같은 전화를 받고 생각에 잠겼다고 했다.)

President Rhee Syngman must have clearly anticipated that such a situation would arise, Baek Seon-yeop thought. He first wanted to ascertain the president's intentions, and if the case required him to step forward, then he thought he should do so. He reportedly called the temporary presidential residence, Gyeongmudae. But it was dawn. The secretary on duty only repeated, "I cannot wake the president." (이승만 대통령 또한 이런 상황이 닥칠지를 분명히 생각했을 것이라고 봤다. 그는 우선 대통령의 의중이 어떤지를 묻고, 전면에 스스로 나서야 하는 경우라면 그래야 한다고 생각했다. 그는 임시 경무대로 전화를 걸었다고 했다. 그러나 새벽이었다. 당직이었던 비서관은 “대통령을 깨울 수 없다”는 말만 반복했다.)

Baek Seon-yeop recounted that he called three times but received the same answer each time. The attitude of the Gyeongmudae secretaries, who were unaware of the gravity of the situation, was consistent. On the final call, Baek Seon-yeop apparently raised his voice. He said, "A major crisis has befallen the Republic of Korea, and if you do not wake His Excellency now, something truly unbearable will happen." Only then did the secretary seem to go to wake the president, it is said. (백선엽은 세 번 전화를 걸었으나 모두 같은 답변만 들었다고 술회했다. 사태의 심각성을 잘 모르는 경무대 비서관들 태도는 한결같았다. 마지막 통화에서 백선엽은 소리를 높였던 모양이다. “대한민국에 이런 큰일이 벌어졌는데, 각하를 지금 깨우지 않으면 정말 감당하기 어려운 일이 벌어진다”고 했다. 그제야 비서관은 대통령을 깨우는 눈치였다고 한다.)

After some time, the president picked up the receiver. Baek Seon-yeop explained the contents of the calls from the U.S. military leadership. In response, President Rhee Syngman answered in a low voice. Baek Seon-yeop recalled that he said, "Yes, I understand. Tell them I did it all. I will issue a press release tomorrow," and then hung up. (조금 시간이 지나자 대통령이 수화기를 들었다. 백선엽은 미군 수뇌부의 전화 내용을 설명했다. 그러자 이승만 대통령은 나지막한 목소리로 이렇게 대답했다. “그래, 알았네. 모두 내가 한 일이라고 해. 내일 프레스 릴리스(press release 언론 보도) 하겠네”라고 말하면서 전화를 끊었다고 백선엽은 회고했다.)

Regarding that incident, which was like a "nuclear bomb" capable of overturning the armistice itself, Washington reportedly plunged into extreme agitation almost immediately. At a Washington meeting presided over by President Eisenhower, remarks even reportedly went as far as discussing the implementation of emergency plans in preparation for a contingency in Korea. (휴전 자체를 뒤집어엎을 만한 ‘핵 폭탄’과도 같았던 그 사태를 두고 워싱턴은 곧바로 극도의 흥분에 빠졌던 모양이다. 아이젠하워 대통령이 주재하는 워싱턴 회의에서는 급기야 한국 유사시에 대비하는 비상 계획 실행을 검토하라는 발언까지 나왔다고 전해진다.)

President Rhee Syngman could have been forced to step down from power due to the strong emergency measures of the U.S. military. But President Rhee was strong. The communist side did not reject the armistice talks altogether over the release of anti-communist prisoners. It was a decisive victory for President Rhee Syngman, who understood the essence of communism, over the United States. Even in the midst of it all, President Rhee kept negotiations and cooperation with the U.S. military in mind, and by saying "Tell them I did it," he shielded and protected Baek Seon-yeop, the linchpin of that role, by keeping him out of the fray. <<>> (이승만 대통령은 미군의 강력한 비상 조치로 인해 강제로 하야(下野)할 수도 있었다. 그러나 이승만 대통령은 강했다. 공산 측이 반공 포로 석방으로 인해 휴전회담 자체를 거부하지 않았던 것이다. 공산주의의 본질을 꿰뚫어 본 이승만 대통령이 미국을 상대로 압승을 거둔 셈이었다. 그 와중에도 이 대통령은 미군과의 교섭과 협력을 염두에 뒀고, 그 역할의 중추였던 백선엽을 “내가 했다고 하게”라며 뒤로 빼 보호했던 것이다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: Jung is a "no centrist" advocate; Jung Cheong-rae: "Violent insult-slinging" (김민석 “鄭 ‘중도는 없다’론자” 정청래 “폭력적 모욕주기”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: Jung is a "no centrist" advocate; Jung Cheong-rae: "Violent insult-slinging" (김민석 “鄭 ‘중도는 없다’론자” 정청래 “폭력적 모욕주기”)

At the first National Assembly member workshop held after Kim Min-seok took office as the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, the "Seok-Cheong (Kim Min-seok and Jung Cheong-rae) conflict" resurfaced. In a public lecture, Representative Kim characterized former Representative Jung as a leading advocate of the "there is no centrist" stance. In response, Jung pushed back, calling it "rude and violent microphone dictatorship" and "one-sided bashing meant to insult." The conflict between factions erupted at an event meant to emphasize "one team" as President Lee's approval rating has plunged to the 30 percent range. (김민석 더불어민주당 대표 취임 후 처음 열린 국회의원 워크숍에서 ‘석청(김민석·정청래) 갈등’이 다시 불거졌다. 김 대표는 공개 강연에서 정 전 대표를 “대표적인 ‘중도는 없다’론자”로 규정했다. 이에 정 전 대표는 “무례하고 폭력적인 마이크 독재”이자 “모욕주기식 일방적 난타”라고 반발했다. 이 대통령 지지율이 30%대까지 추락하며 ‘원팀’을 강조하려고 마련한 자리에서 계파 갈등이 표출된 것이다.)

The Democratic Party held a two-day workshop in Incheon starting on the 27th. The event began on a warm note, with Representative Kim personally presenting flowers and a plaque of appreciation to former Representative Jung, who was the previous party leader. The plaque read: "You served as party leader with dedication and led the way for the development of the Democratic Party with all your heart and effort." (민주당은 27일 1박2일 일정으로 인천에서 워크숍을 개최했다. 이날 행사는 김 대표가 전임 대표였던 정 전 대표에게 직접 꽃다발과 감사패를 전달하며 훈훈하게 시작됐다. 감사패에는 ‘당 대표직을 수행하며 열과 성을 다해 민주당의 발전을 위해 앞장서 주셨다’는 글귀가 적혀 있었다.)

Afterward, Representative Kim gave a 20-minute lecture under the theme "The Golden Age of Democracy," during which he revealed conversations he had with former Representative Jung. The content concerned their differences in political direction. Kim said, "Former Representative Jung is a leading advocate of the 'there is no centrist' stance" and "takes the position that unity is ultimately the path to victory." He added, "In contrast, I believe—and I think the President likely shares a similar view—that expansion toward the moderate conservative spectrum is necessary." Kim emphasized, "The livelihood, pragmatism, and expansion line is the line of our government, and it is the party line chosen by an overwhelming number of party members at the August 17 party convention." He also noted, "I have reached a tentative conclusion that it is difficult to find a compromise (with Jung)." (이후 김 대표는 ‘민주의 황금시대’를 주제로 20분간 강연하며 정 전 대표와 나눈 대화를 공개했다. 노선 차이를 느꼈다는 내용이었다. 김 대표는 “정 전 대표님은 대표적인 ‘중도는 없다’론자”라며 “단결하는 것이 결국 승리하는 길이라고 보는 입장”이라고 했다. 이어 “그에 반해 저는, 아마 대통령도 비슷한 생각일 것이라고 보는데, 중도 보수의 확장이 필요하다고 보는 의견”이라고 했다. 김 대표는 “민생·실용·확장 노선이 우리 정부의 노선이고 이번 8·17 전당대회에서 압도적 당원들이 선택한 당의 노선”이라고 강조했다. 그러면서 “(정 전 대표와) 절충하기가 좀 어렵다는 잠정적 결론을 내렸다”고도 했다.)

Representative Kim holds the position that only through the "structural majority" advocated by President Lee Jae-myung—embracing moderates and conservatives alike—can the party achieve "consecutive governance." However, former Representative Jung and figures like Yoo Si-min argue that rallying the Democratic Party's traditional support base is the key to "regime re-creation." On that day, Kim also criticized Yoo Si-min's "ABC theory," which divides Democratic Party supporters into three categories. Yoo had predicted that B, referring to "New Lee Jae-myung," would be the first to turn away from the current administration. In response, Kim said, "I don't think that's particularly accurate." (김 대표는 이재명 대통령이 주장해온 ‘구조적 다수’를 통해 중도·보수까지 껴안는 대통합을 해야만 ‘연속 집권’이 가능하다는 입장이다. 하지만 정 전 대표와 유시민씨 등은 민주당 전통 지지층을 결집시켜야만 ‘정권 재창출’을 할 수 있다는 쪽이다. 김 대표는 이날 유시민씨가 민주당 지지층을 세 가지로 나눈 ‘ABC론’도 비판했다. 유씨는 이 중 ‘뉴이재명’을 뜻하는 B가 가장 먼저 현 정권에 등을 돌릴 것이라고 전망한 바 있다. 이에 대해 김 대표는 “별로 맞다고 생각하지 않는다”고 했다.)

In response, former Representative Jung expressed displeasure and left the workshop midway. He later wrote on Facebook, targeting Kim, "I express regret over the use of my real name as a tool for your argumentation" and called the "one-sided assertions made by name, cutting off all context, almost violent." Pro-Jung lawmakers also joined in. Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yun wrote on Facebook, "Is it appropriate to publicly insult a former party leader and rival in the party convention?" adding, "The theory of expanding toward moderate pragmatism is not an absolute truth either." Lawmaker Moon Jeong-bok also told reporters, "Did he have to drag out a one- or two-minute conversation and unilaterally bring it up? It was inappropriate." (그러자 정 전 대표는 불쾌감을 드러내며 워크숍 도중 자리를 떠났다. 이후 페이스북에 김 대표를 향해 “제 실명을 거론하며 자신의 논리 전개 도구로 사용한 것에 유감을 표한다”며 “거두절미 앞뒤 자르고 실명을 거명하며 일방적으로 주장한 것은 거의 폭력적”이라고 썼다. 친청계 의원들도 가세했다. 이성윤 최고위원은 페이스북에 “전당대회 경쟁자이자 이전 당대표를 공개모욕을 주는 것이 과연 맞냐”며 “중도 실용 외연 확장론도 절대 진리는 아닐 것“이라고 했다. 문정복 의원도 기자들과 만나 “굳이 그분하고 얘기했던 1~2분의 대화를 끌어다가 일방적으로 얘기를 했어야 되느냐. 적절하지 않았다”고 했다.)

As controversy grew, Representative Kim posted on X (formerly Twitter), saying, "If I caused discomfort, I ask for your understanding." A key party official said, "With the President's approval rating in the '30s' and the Blue House issuing an official statement vowing to do its best, we held the workshop for the sake of unity—but all that remains is the Seok-Cheong conflict." (논란이 되자 김 대표는 엑스(X)에 글을 올려 “불편을 드렸다면 이해를 구한다”고 했다. 민주당 핵심 관계자는 “대통령 지지율이 ‘30%대’가 나오고 청와대가 최선을 다하겠다는 공식 입장까지 낸 상황에서 화합 차원의 워크숍을 열었는데, 석청 갈등만 남았다”고 했다.)

At the closed-door workshop that day, analysis and discussions regarding the decline in the President's approval rating reportedly continued. It was also revealed that an internal poll showed 59.3 percent of supporters in the capital region might withdraw their support due to real estate issues. Data also showed that 32.7 percent of Democratic Party supporters from the last presidential election had weakened in their support, and 70.3 percent of those in their 20s and 30s said "the Democratic Party does not understand us." In the National Barometer Survey (NBS) released that day, President Lee's approval rating stood at 50 percent, down 19 percentage points in four months. Additionally, 63 percent agreed with the claim that President Lee should state he would not run in the next presidential election if the constitution is amended. (이날 비공개 워크숍에선 대통령 지지율 하락과 관련한 분석과 논의가 이어졌다고 한다. 수도권 지지자의 59.3%가 부동산 문제로 지지를 철회할 가능성이 있다는 자체 여론조사 결과도 공개된 것으로 알려졌다. 지난 대선 민주당 지지자의 32.7%는 지지세가 약화됐고, 2030세대의 70.3%는 “민주당이 우리를 이해하지 못한다”는 내용도 나왔다. 이날 전국지표조사(NBS)에선 이 대통령 국정 지지율은 50%로 4개월 만에 19%포인트 하락했다. 이 대통령이 개헌 시 차기 대선에 출마하지 않겠다는 입장을 밝혀야 한다는 주장에는 63%가 동의했다.)

Amid this situation, the Blue House also canceled a luncheon scheduled for the 28th between President Lee Jae-myung and all Democratic Party lawmakers. A ruling camp official said, "It's due to the Nepal flood situation, but the approval rating likely had an influence as well." (이런 가운데 청와대는 28일 예정됐던 이재명 대통령과 민주당 의원 전체 오찬도 취소했다. 여권 관계자는 “네팔 홍수 사태 때문이지만 지지율도 영향을 미치지 않았겠느냐”고 했다.)

item.title: Park Geun-hye attends People Power Party workshop for first time in 14 years (14년 만에 국힘 연찬회 간 박근혜)
item.description:
Park Geun-hye attends People Power Party workshop for first time in 14 years (14년 만에 국힘 연찬회 간 박근혜)

The People Power Party (PPP) held a legislative workshop on the 27th to discuss response strategies for the regular session of the National Assembly in September. The party leadership invited former President Park Geun-hye, sending a message to "unite in the fight against the opposition." However, some lawmakers in attendance said, "There was no discussion of specific reform visions or innovation plans for the next general election." (국민의힘은 27일 국회의원 연찬회를 열고 9월 정기 국회 대응 전략 등을 논의했다. 당 지도부는 박근혜 전 대통령을 초청해 “대여 투쟁으로 뭉치자”는 메시지를 냈다. 하지만 참석한 일부 의원은 “다음 총선을 위한 구체적 개혁 비전이나 혁신 방안에 대한 토론은 없었다”고 했다.)

Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said in his speech at the workshop held at Sono Calm Hotel in Goyang, Gyeonggi Province, that day: "We must thoroughly expose the misgovernment and tyranny of the Lee Jae-myung regime and present our party's proper alternatives," adding, "Let us resist and block it together with the people." Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik said, "The past year of the Lee Jae-myung government has been a year of destruction and dismantlement," and "We must point out, item by item, what went wrong in each standing committee and offer alternatives." (장동혁 대표는 이날 경기 고양 소노캄 호텔에서 열린 의원 연찬회 연설에서 “이재명 정권의 실정과 폭정을 낱낱이 파헤치고, 우리 당의 올바른 대안을 제시해야 한다”며 “국민과 함께 저항하고 막아내자”고 했다. 정점식 원내대표는 “이재명 정부의 지난 1년은 파괴와 해체의 1년이었다”며 “각 상임위에서 무엇이 잘못됐는지 조목조목 지적하고 대안을 제시해야 한다”고 했다.)

Afterward, special lectures followed on topics such as artificial intelligence (AI), diplomatic security, and conflict resolution. One first-term lawmaker said, "It wasn't a lecture on party innovation, nor was it an atmosphere conducive to open discussion." According to the PPP, 101 of the 109 lawmakers attended the event. Among those recently disciplined with suspension of party membership by the party's ethics committee, lawmakers Kwon Young-jin, Seo Beom-su, and Jin Jong-oh, excluding Cho Kyoung-tae, did not attend. (이후 인공지능(AI), 외교 안보, 갈등 해소를 주제로 한 특강이 이어졌다. 한 초선 의원은 “당 혁신과 관련한 강연을 들은 것도 아니고, 자유 토론이 이뤄지는 분위기도 아니었다”고 했다. 국민의힘에 따르면 이날 행사엔 의원 109명 중 101명이 참석했다. 최근 당 윤리위원회에서 당원권 정지 징계를 받은 사람 가운데 조경태 의원을 제외한 권영진·서범수·진종오 의원 등은 불참했다.)

Former President Park Geun-hye also attended the workshop that day. Park was expelled from the Liberty Korea Party (the PPP's predecessor) in 2017 over the "national power abuse" scandal and holds no party membership, but she campaigned for PPP candidates during the last local elections. On this day, she also took the stage to speak at the request of Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik. It was her first time joining lawmakers at a workshop since attending one for the Saenuri Party (formerly the PPP) in 2012 when she was a presidential candidate, marking 14 years. (이날 연찬회에는 박근혜 전 대통령도 참석했다. 박 전 대통령은 ‘국정 농단’ 사건으로 2017년 자유한국당(국민의힘 전신)에서 출당돼 당적이 없지만 지난 지방선거 때 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세를 했다. 이날도 정점식 원내대표 요청에 따라 연설에 나섰다. 박 전 대통령은 대선 후보였던 2012년 새누리당(옛 국민의힘) 의원 연찬회에 참석한 후 14년 만에 의원들과 함께했다.)

Former President Park said, "Within a political party, various opinions may emerge, but we must not hate or deny one another," and "In difficult times, we must unite in solidarity around the leadership and move forward." She also emphasized "Mushin bulnip (no standing without trust)," stating, "If there is no trust within a party, that party cannot survive." She then compared the struggles of a minority opposition party to "the process of a caterpillar becoming a butterfly," adding, "A time of desperate struggle is needed." As she concluded her speech, Park asked, "Can I trust you and move forward?" and lawmakers responded with a standing ovation. (박 전 대통령은 “정당 내에서 다양한 의견이 나올 수 있지만 서로를 증오하고 부정해서는 안 된다”며 “어려운 때일수록 지도부를 중심으로 일치단결해서 나아가야 한다”고 했다. 또 “정당 내에서 신의가 없으면 그 정당은 존립할 수 없다”며 ‘무신불립(無信不立·신뢰 없이 설 수 없다)’을 강조했다. 이어 소수 야당의 어려움을 “애벌레가 나비가 되는 과정”에 비유하며 “처절한 발버둥의 시간이 필요하다”고 했다. 박 전 대통령은 연설을 마무리하며 “제가 여러분을 믿고 가도 되겠느냐”고 물었고, 의원들은 기립 박수를 보냈다.)

A PPP official said, "Since the party has been repeating internal strife, former President Park seems to have emphasized 'unity over division.'" Some within the party interpret that the move may reflect the intentions of mainstream lawmakers seeking to create a focal point around Park. After Park's speech, Chairman Jang told reporters, "If we look in different directions or pick fights internally, that is not trust, in my view." (국민의힘 관계자는 “당이 내분을 반복하고 있으니 박 전 대통령이 ‘분열보다 단합’을 강조한 것 같다”고 했다. 당 일각에선 박 전 대통령을 중심으로 구심점을 만들어보자는 구주류 의원들의 의중이 반영된 것 아니겠느냐는 해석도 나온다. 장 대표는 박 전 대통령 연설 후 기자들과 만나 “다른 방향을 보고 가거나, 우리 내부를 향해서 싸움을 건다면 신의는 아니라고 생각한다”고 했다.)

That day, some lawmakers also reacted that "inviting an impeached president at a time when we should be talking about party innovation was inappropriate." One three-term lawmaker said, "It's regrettable that our party seems to be returning to the past rather than the future." A two-term lawmaker expressed concern, saying, "I worry the public will see us as 'an opposition party with no will to reform.'" (이날 일부 의원은 “당의 혁신을 말해야 할 시점에 탄핵당한 대통령을 부른 것은 적절치 않았다”는 반응도 보였다. 한 3선 의원은 “우리 당이 미래가 아닌 과거로 회귀하는 것 같아 아쉽다”고 했다. 한 재선 의원은 “국민에게 ‘쇄신 의지가 없는 야당’으로 비칠까 걱정”이라고 했다.)

]]>

item.title: Audit Board Moves to Quash Statistics Manipulation Findings Under Moon Government... "Coercive Audits Under Previous Administration" (文정부 통계조작 무마하나… 감사원 “前정부서 강압 감사”)
item.description:
Audit Board Moves to Quash Statistics Manipulation Findings Under Moon Government... "Coercive Audits Under Previous Administration" (文정부 통계조작 무마하나… 감사원 “前정부서 강압 감사”)

The Board of Audit and Inspection effectively reversed its own previous audit findings on Monday, which had concluded that statistics were manipulated and distorted during the Moon Jae-in administration. The board's "Special Committee Follow-up Task Force (TF)," which has been investigating the statistics manipulation audit team, announced that it found coercive statements had been made to officials from the Moon administration's Blue House, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and the Korea Real Estate Board during the audit process, and that mobile phone forensics were also conducted unlawfully. The board has called for severe disciplinary action—including dismissal, removal, demotion, or suspension—against 10 working-level members of the audit team, and has referred nine of them to the police on charges including abuse of authority. <<> In September 2023, the Board of Audit and Inspection had released audit findings stating that the Moon administration had manipulated and distorted statistics on housing, income, and employment across most of its five-year term. However, after the Lee Jae-myung administration took office last year and the Democratic Party repeatedly claimed the audit was itself "fabricated," the board formed a task force to investigate the audit team. <<> The board's TF stated that the audit team made pressure-laden remarks during or around the question-and-answer sessions with real estate statistics officials, such as "If you don't cooperate, your public service career is over" and "If this continues, Korea Real Estate Board employees could face restructuring." It also said the team refused requests from auditees to correct portions of the statements that differed from what they had actually said, and that fabricated content was dressed up as auditee testimony in investigation referral requests sent to prosecutors. The TF further found that "emergency forensics"—which should only be conducted when an auditee voluntarily submits their phone and requests it—were carried out under duress, with documents falsified to make it appear the requests had been voluntary. <<> The auditors facing severe discipline have pushed back, saying, "We did not conduct coercive investigations or force anyone to make statements." They also said, "Through objective evidence—including KakaoTalk messages, internal work communications, and records of sample price modifications in computer systems from the Blue House, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and the Korea Real Estate Board—the audit team specifically confirmed the process by which the Blue House and the ministry's demands actually led to downward adjustments in (housing price increase) statistics." <<> Nevertheless, based on the TF's conclusions, the board plans to re-deliberate and re-adjudicate its previous audit report concluding that the Moon government manipulated statistics. This could also influence the ongoing first-instance trial in which prosecutors, relying on evidence collected by the board, have investigated and indicted those accused of statistics manipulation. (감사원이 문재인 정부 시절 통계 조작·왜곡이 있었다는 과거 감사 결과를 27일 사실상 스스로 뒤집었다. 통계 조작 감사팀을 조사해 온 감사원 ‘국조특위 후속 조치 TF(태스크포스)’는 감사 과정에서 문재인 정부 청와대와 국토교통부, 한국부동산원 관계자들에 대한 진술 강요 등이 있었고 휴대전화 포렌식도 위법하게 이뤄졌다는 결론을 냈다고 발표했다. 감사원은 당시 감사팀 실무자 10명에 대해 파면·해임·강등·정직 등 중징계를 요구하고, 그 중 9명은 직권 남용 등 혐의로 경찰에 고발했다.)

item.title: Instead of Dropping the Indictment, Exemption for Daejang-dong? Blue House Leans Toward ‘Special Act After Abolishing Breach of Duty’ (공소 취소 대신 대장동 면소? 靑 ‘배임죄 없앤 뒤 특례법’ 가닥)
item.description:
Instead of Dropping the Indictment, Exemption for Daejang-dong? Blue House Leans Toward ‘Special Act After Abolishing Breach of Duty’ (공소 취소 대신 대장동 면소? 靑 ‘배임죄 없앤 뒤 특례법’ 가닥)

The Blue House has reportedly decided to move toward abolishing the current crime of breach of duty and enacting a special law to replace it, picking up the pace as of the 27th. This reportedly reflects the judgment that legal revisions are needed ahead of large-scale semiconductor company investment in the government’s ‘three major mega projects.’ However, some in political circles are saying about the speed behind the abolition of the breach of duty crime, “Isn’t it because of the Daejang-dong case trial, where President Lee Jae-myung was indicted on breach of duty charges?” If the crime of breach of duty disappears, President Lee is highly likely to receive an ‘exemption from prosecution (免訴)’ ruling on his breach of duty charges. <<> A government official said, “The abolition of the breach of duty crime was originally deliberated by the Ministry of Justice, the lead ministry, weighing two options: maintaining the current breach of duty crime but supplementing it to prevent excessive application, or abolishing the crime and creating a new replacement law,” adding, “In this situation, the Blue House has effectively set the direction toward abolition.” The Blue House has reportedly recently instructed the Ministry of Justice to actively consider ‘abolition’ rather than ‘retention’ of the breach of duty crime. <<> Within the ruling camp, the ‘Honam semiconductor’ initiative and other three major mega projects recently promoted by the government were also cited as reasons for the need to abolish the breach of duty crime, according to reports. A key ruling camp figure said, “If Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix’s Honam semiconductor investment later gets politically investigated as breach of duty after a possible change in administration, that would be a problem,” adding, “To eliminate such a possibility, the breach of duty crime must be abolished.” However, the Blue House side said regarding the abolition, “No final plan has been confirmed yet,” and that it is “reviewing various measures to reduce the harms of applying the breach of duty crime.” <<> Initially, the abolition of the breach of duty crime was driven after the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, with President Lee Jae-myung expressing his will and the ruling party leading the effort. In July of last year, President Lee ordered institutional improvements at an emergency economic task force meeting, saying, “The abuse of the breach of duty crime is shrinking corporate activity.” In September of last year, the government and ruling party held a party-government consultation and publicly announced their push to abolish the breach of duty crime. President Lee reportedly also ordered a ‘speed push’ for abolition when meeting with Democratic Party lawmakers in January of this year. <<> However, progress stalled due to overlapping political schedules such as local elections and concerns about public backlash if the abolition proceeded. On the 5th, then-Minister of Justice Jung Sung-ho said at a pre-briefing for the presidential work report that whether to abolish the breach of duty crime had not yet been decided, stating, “We have analyzed about 3,500 breach of duty precedents over the past five years and are in the final stage of gathering academic opinions.” He only added, “We are also discussing with Blue House aides, so improvements will come soon.” <<> The discussion on the breach of duty crime is known to have remained at a standstill because concerns poured in from the legal community, academia, and civil society regarding its abolition. Additionally, within the Ministry of Justice, which prepares government legislation, the opinion favoring ‘retention’ rather than ‘abolition’ reportedly prevailed. A Ministry of Justice official said, “There was a need for improvement because the existing breach of duty crime has been criticized as ‘whatever you want it to be,’ being applied arbitrarily in corporate investigations, with not a few cases ending in acquittals years later in court,” adding, “But since abolishing the crime would create a ‘legal vacuum’ where punishment becomes difficult, prosecutors more strongly favored clarifying the elements of the existing law to minimize side effects.” <<> In particular, it was reported that even some within the ruling camp expressed concerns, saying, “If we push for abolition, we’ll obviously be attacked for ‘erasing the president’s trial.’” President Lee was brought to trial in 2023 over breach of duty charges involving thousands of billions of won in the ‘Daejang-dong case.’ The first-instance trial has been suspended since President Lee took office. Legal circles believe that if the breach of duty crime is abolished, even if a replacement special law is created, President Lee is highly likely to receive an exemption from prosecution ruling in his trial. <<> Some in the opposition camp have said, “Since passing a special prosecution law for manipulated indictments to drop the charges in the president’s case has become difficult, they are seeking a detour to eliminate President Lee’s trial.” The Democratic Party pushed for a special prosecution law before the June election but put it on hold due to public backlash, and now there is a skeptical mood about pursuing the special prosecution itself amid falling presidential approval ratings. This is why they are speeding up the abolition of the breach of duty crime as a kind of alternative. However, a Blue House official said, “The president has called for reforming the breach of duty crime since before taking office,” and “The abolition of the breach of duty crime and the trial are unrelated.” (청와대가 최근 현행 배임죄를 폐지하고 이를 대체할 특례법을 제정하는 쪽으로 가닥을 잡고 속도를 내는 것으로 27일 알려졌다. 정부가 추진하는 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’에 반도체 기업의 대규모 투자를 앞두고 관련 법 손질이 필요하다는 판단이 반영됐다고 한다. 하지만 정치권 일각에선 배임죄 폐지에 속도를 내는 배경을 두고 “이재명 대통령이 배임 혐의로 기소된 대장동 사건 재판 때문 아니겠느냐”는 말이 나온다. 배임죄가 사라지면 이 대통령의 배임 혐의가 ‘면소(免訴)’ 판결을 받을 가능성이 크기 때문이다.)

item.title: Lee Meets Heads of Basic Local Governments: "The Farther from Seoul, the Stronger the Support" (기초단체장들 만난 李 “서울서 멀수록 두텁게 지원”)
item.description:
Lee Meets Heads of Basic Local Governments: "The Farther from Seoul, the Stronger the Support" (기초단체장들 만난 李 “서울서 멀수록 두텁게 지원”)

President Lee Jae-myung held a luncheon meeting with mayors, county governors, and district heads at Cheong Wa Dae on the 27th and stated, "We will expand the practical authority and finances of local governments," adding, "The farther the distance from Seoul, the stronger the support we will provide." He asked the heads of basic local governments to refer to themselves as 'local governments' rather than 'local administrative bodies,' while also urging them, as they are on the front lines of people's livelihoods, to "take good care so that no one loses their life due to economic hardship." (이재명 대통령이 27일 청와대에서 시장·군수·구청장 초청 오찬 간담회를 갖고 “지방정부의 실질적 권한과 재정을 확대하겠다”며 “서울에서 거리가 멀수록 더 두텁게 지원하겠다”고 밝혔다. 기초단체장들에게는 ‘지방자치단체’가 아니라 ‘지방정부’로 스스로를 불러 달라고 하는 한편, 민생 최전선에 있는 만큼 “경제적 어려움으로 목숨을 잃는 사람이 없도록 잘 보살펴 달라”고도 했다.)

Regarding the issue of local extinction, President Lee said, "We have established a special local exemption system so that the farther from Seoul, the stronger the support can be, and based on this, we are continuously discovering new support tailored to local areas through these special exemptions." The system he referenced is the 'Local Preference Index.' It is an index that comprehensively factors in distance from Seoul, regional social and economic indicators, and population decline crisis levels, and is currently applied to seven programs, including child allowances and senior job opportunities. The government plans to significantly expand the number of programs next year, allocating more budget to regions with higher index scores. (이 대통령은 지방 소멸 문제와 관련해 “서울에서 거리가 멀수록 더 두텁게 지원될 수 있도록 지방 특례 제도를 마련했고, 또 이를 토대로 지방에 특화된 지원이 가도록 지방 특례를 통해 새롭게 계속 발굴해 나가고 있다”고 했다. 이 대통령이 언급한 제도는 ‘지방우대지수’다. 서울과의 거리, 지역별 사회·경제 지표, 인구 소멸 위기 등을 종합한 지수로 현재 아동수당, 노인 일자리 등 7개 사업에 적용되고 있다. 정부는 내년에는 사업 수를 대폭 확대해 지수가 높은 지역에 더 예산을 배정한다는 방침이다.)

President Lee also asked the heads to "take good care so that no one loses their life due to economic hardship." A Cheong Wa Dae official explained, "The President has always had a strong interest in the issue of suicide, and since the heads are the ones who encounter residents' lives most closely, this was a request to pay close attention to such matters." (이 대통령은 “경제적 어려움으로 목숨을 잃는 사람이 없도록 잘 보살펴 달라”고 단체장들에게 부탁하기도 했다. 청와대 관계자는 “평소 대통령이 자살 문제에 관심이 높기도 하고, 단체장들이 주민들의 삶을 가장 가까이에서 마주하는 분들인 만큼 이런 부분을 잘 챙겨 달라는 의미”라고 설명했다.)

Cho Jae-gu, chairman of the Association of Mayors, County Governors, and District Heads (and mayor of Nam-gu, Daegu), who delivered remarks on behalf of the attendees, expressed gratitude that the association chairman would begin attending State Council meetings starting in August. The government recently officially designated the chairman of the Association of Mayors, County Governors, and District Heads of the Republic of Korea as a participant in State Council meetings. (참석자를 대표해 인사한 조재구 시장·군수·구청장협의회장(대구 남구청장)이 8월부터 협의회장이 국무회의에 배석하게 된 점에 사의를 표했다. 정부는 최근 대한민국시장·군수·구청장협의회장을 국무회의 배석 대상으로 공식 지정했다.)

Earlier, President Lee had met with heads of metropolitan governments the previous day and stated, "Alongside the three major mega-projects, the government is also devoting full efforts to fostering next-generation strategic industries that will support locally led growth." At that meeting, Gyeonggi Province Governor Choo Mi-ae said, "The first reality I faced after taking office was the very severe fiscal crisis of Gyeonggi Province. On the surface, the budget exceeds 40 trillion won, making finances seem ample, but the actual fiscal conditions have seen deficits of 1 to 2 trillion won accumulate for years, and we are facing structural limits that cannot be overcome through our own efforts alone." (앞서 이 대통령은 전날 광역단체장들과 만나 “정부는 3대 메가 프로젝트와 함께 지방 주도 성장을 뒷받침할 차세대 전략 산업 육성에도 총력을 기울이고 있다”고 한 바 있다. 이 자리에서 추미애 경기도지사는 “도정을 맡은 이후 가장 먼저 마주한 현실은 매우 엄중한 경기도의 재정 위기였다”며 “겉으로는 40조원을 넘는 예산 규모로 재정이 넉넉해 보이지만 실제 재정 여건은 수년째 1조~2조원 적자가 누적돼 자체적인 노력만으로는 극복하기 어려운 구조적 한계에 직면해 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Breaking Through Internal and External Crises with People-First Principle... All Lawmakers to Sprint at Full Speed" (김민석 “민생 제일주의로 내우외환 돌파…모든 의원 전력 질주”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: "Breaking Through Internal and External Crises with People-First Principle... All Lawmakers to Sprint at Full Speed" (김민석 “민생 제일주의로 내우외환 돌파…모든 의원 전력 질주”)

Kim Min-seok, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, on the 28th wrapped up the lawmakers' workshop by emphasizing the "people-first principle." As some polls recently showed a decline in President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating, the party leadership has signaled a focus on livelihood policies while setting aside contentious legislative issues. (김민석 더불어민주당 대표는 28일 의원 워크숍을 마무리하며 ‘민생 제일주의’를 언급했다. 최근 이재명 대통령 지지율이 하락했다는 일부 조사가 발표된 가운데, 민주당 지도부에선 논란이 있는 쟁점 법안 등은 미루고 민생 정책에 주력하겠다는 발언이 나오고 있다.)

On the second day of the workshop, at an open supreme council meeting held on site in Incheon, Kim said, "This workshop was a gathering to reaffirm our resolve to break through internal and external crises with the people-first principle at this desperate turning point toward Korea's golden era." (김 대표는 이날 워크숍 이틀 차를 맞아 인천 현장에서 진행한 공개 최고위에서 “이번 워크숍은 K 황금시대로 향하는 절박한 분기점에서 민생 제일주의로 내우외환을 돌파하자는 결의를 다지는 워크숍이었다”고 했다.)

He added, "To open a golden era of democracy, popular sovereignty, and the Republic of Korea, I will run the party with the resolve and determination that every Democratic Party lawmaker is a principal actor in solving the challenges at hand." He continued, "Starting today, we will enter a total-effort system in which all lawmakers sprint at full speed, and the party thoroughly supports and fully monitors them. Soon, every lawmaker will receive specific missions from the party." (그는 “민주주의, 국민 주권, 대한민국의 황금시대를 열기 위해 민주당 의원 전원이 과제 해결의 주체가 된다는 결의와 각오로 당을 운영하겠다”고 했다. 이어 “모든 의원이 전력 질주하게 하고 당은 그것을 철저하게 지원하고 완벽하게 점검하는 총력전 체제로 오늘 이후 돌입할 것”이라며 “조만간 의원 전원이 당으로부터 구체적인 미션을 부여받게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Kim said, "The party posts (personnel appointments) are currently underway," adding, "Through individual conversations with all lawmakers, I will assign optimal tasks in appropriate formats." (김 대표는 “현재 당직(인선)이 진행 중”이라며 “모든 의원들과 개별적인 대화를 통해 최적의 임무를 적절한 형식으로 맡기게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the Bank of Korea's upward revision of this year's gross domestic product (GDP) growth forecast, Kim said, "This is the effect of the semiconductor boom and thanks to businesses and the people," adding, "We will do our utmost in handling legislation and the budget bill to ensure this momentum continues steadily." (김 대표는 한국은행의 올해 국내총생산(GDP) 성장률 상향 조정과 관련해 “반도체 호황의 효과이고 기업과 국민 여러분 덕분”이라며 “이 흐름을 확실하게 이어갈 수 있도록 입법과 예산안 처리에 만전을 기하겠다”고 했다.)

On the Bank of Korea's base rate hike, he said, "It likely reflects a comprehensive consideration of factors such as prices, household debt, and the exchange rate," while adding, "The party will not let its guard down, keeping a close eye on market and livelihood conditions to ensure the rate hike does not place excessive repayment burdens on financially vulnerable groups, and we will prepare measures if necessary." (한국은행의 기준금리 인상에 대해 “물가, 가계부채, 환율 등 여러 요건을 종합 고려한 결정일 것”이라면서도 “당에서는 긴장을 늦추지 않고 시장과 민생 상황을 살피면서 금리 인상이 금융 취약 계층에 과도한 상환 부담으로 이어지지 않도록 주시하고 필요할 경우 대책을 마련하겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the nine Korean nationals missing due to flooding in Nepal, Kim said, "We earnestly pray for their safe return," adding, "Floor leader (Han Byeong-do) will take care of all necessary matters at the National Assembly level." (김 대표는 네팔 홍수로 인한 우리 국민 9명 실종과 관련해 “실종자의 무사 귀환을 간절히 기원한다”며 “(한병도) 원내대표가 국회 차원에서 필요한 모든 일을 챙길 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Han Byung-do: "Not a single second of the regular session should be wasted" (한병도 “정기국회 단 1초도 허비돼선 안돼”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do: "Not a single second of the regular session should be wasted" (한병도 “정기국회 단 1초도 허비돼선 안돼”       )

Democratic Party of Korea floor leader Han Byung-do said on the 28th, "Not a single second of the precious time of the regular session should be wasted due to the People Power Party's tantrums and obstruction." (더불어민주당 한병도 원내대표는 28일 “국민의힘의 몽니와 발목잡기 때문에 정기국회의 천금 같은 시간이 단 1초도 허비되어서는 안 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Floor leader Han made these remarks during a Supreme Council meeting held at Inspire Hotel in Incheon, saying, "Does the People Power Party truly not hear the people's voice telling them to get some work done?" (한 원내대표는 이날 인천 인스파이어 호텔에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “국민의힘은 일 좀 하라는 국민의 목소리가 정녕 들리지 않느냐”라며 이같이 말했다.)

He said, "While the Democratic Party was devoted to drafting a future vision for economic recovery and livelihood restoration at yesterday's (workshop), the People Power Party held a retreat and hurled all sorts of abuse and harsh words at the government. They keep delaying the formation of the National Assembly's second-half leadership, obstruct every piece of legislation at every turn, and now I cannot help but ask whether they intend to turn even the regular session into a battleground for political strife." (그는 “어제 (워크숍에서) 민주당이 민생 회복과 경제 도약을 위한 미래 비전 구상에 매진하는 사이 국민의힘은 연찬회를 열어 정부에 온갖 악담과 독설을 퍼부었다”며 “후반기 국회 원 구성을 차일피일 미루고 법안 처리에도 사사건건 발목을 잡더니 이제는 정기국회마저 정쟁의 장으로 변질시킬 셈인지 묻지 않을 수 없다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Let's set aside outdated partisan interests and political infighting, and at least in this regular session, put our heads together and work for the people's livelihoods. I also warn them: do not harbor the futile hope that you can stop the clock of the National Assembly through irresponsible obstruction of state affairs." (이어 “낡은 당리당략과 정쟁을 미뤄두고 이번 정기국회만큼은 민생을 위해 머리를 맞대고 일하자”며 “또한 경고한다. 무책임한 국정 발목 잡기로 국회의 시계를 멈출 수 있을 것이라는 헛된 기대는 하지 마시라”고 말했다.)

item.title: National Security Office Chief: "Support Resumption of North Korea-U.S. Dialogue... Cautious to Avoid 'Korea Passing'" (위성락 “북미대화 재개 지원… ‘한국 패싱’ 없도록 유의”)
item.description:
National Security Office Chief: "Support Resumption of North Korea-U.S. Dialogue... Cautious to Avoid 'Korea Passing'" (위성락 “북미대화 재개 지원… ‘한국 패싱’ 없도록 유의”)

National Security Office Chief Wi Sung-lac said on the 28th that if North Korea-U.S. dialogue resumes in the future, "ensuring that our security posture is not relaxed or that Korea is not bypassed is one of the points of caution." This follows President Trump's instruction on the 16th (local time) to reduce South Korea-U.S. joint exercises, signaling his intention to resume dialogue with North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un. In this process, concerns have been raised that our government could be "bypassed" in the North Korea-U.S. dialogue phase. (위성락 국가안보실장이 28일 향후 북미 대화가 재개될 경우 “우리의 안보 태세가 이완되거나, 한국이 패싱되는 일이 없도록 하는 것도 유의점 중 하나”라고 밝혔다. 앞서 트럼프 대통령은 지난 16일(현지 시각) 한-미 연합훈련 축소를 지시하며 김정은 북한 국무위원장과의 대화 재개 의사를 내비쳤다. 이 과정에서 우리 정부가 북미 간 대화 국면에서 ‘패싱’될 수 있다는 우려가 제기되고 있다.)

In a briefing at the presidential office that day, Chief Wi stated, "As a party to peace on the Korean Peninsula and a pacemaker, we will support building trust between North Korea and the United States and the resumption of dialogue so that President Trump's efforts lead to the restart of North Korea-U.S. talks." He added, "At the same time, we intend to take a multi-dimensional approach to duly prepare for the points we should be mindful of in this process. One of the points of caution is to cooperate with the U.S. side so that the resumption of North Korea-U.S. dialogue achieves substantial progress on the North Korean nuclear issue along with the establishment of a peace regime on the Korean Peninsula." <<> Chief Wi particularly emphasized, "At the same time, ensuring that our security posture is not relaxed or that Korea is not bypassed in this process is also one of the points of caution." This means that while supporting direct North Korea-U.S. dialogue, the government would guard against situations where Korea is excluded from the negotiation process or its security posture is weakened. <<> Chief Wi said, "To facilitate these efforts smoothly, policy coordination and communication between South Korea and the U.S. are more important than ever." He added, "There are various pending issues between South Korea and the U.S. right now, including investment, Coupang, security cooperation, intelligence cooperation, and the transfer of wartime operational control. The government is making efforts to strengthen the South Korea-U.S. coordination system by properly managing these issues." He also noted that the government has been maintaining communication with the U.S. side at various levels, including a foreign ministers' phone call on the 24th. <<> The high-level diplomatic and security channel between South Korea and China has also been reactivated after about five years. Chief Wi said he had talks and a luncheon with Wang Yi, Director of the Chinese Communist Party's Central Foreign Affairs Commission Office, on the 20th, lasting nearly two hours, and assessed, "This means the dialogue channel between South Korea's National Security Office chief and China's Central Foreign Affairs Commission Office director, which was suspended after December 2021, has been reopened after about five years." The two sides agreed to operate this channel regularly and to discuss Chief Wi's visit to China. They also decided to begin preparations for follow-up projects from the summit exchange on the occasion of President Yoon's attendance at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen in November. <<> Regarding Korean Peninsula issues, Chief Wi said he explained to the Chinese side President Yoon's policy of peaceful coexistence presented in his Liberation Day commemorative speech, and "mentioned our position on denuclearization and the establishment of peace in detail." Director Wang reportedly stated that China's policy on the Korean Peninsula maintains continuity and stability, and expressed its intention to continue playing a constructive role for peace and stability on the peninsula. item.title: Opposition: "Cho Hee-dae must voluntarily withdraw Supreme Court justice nomination... Re-nominate from remaining candidates" (與 “조희대, 대법관 제청 자진 철회해야…나머지 후보 중 재제청”)
item.description:
Opposition: "Cho Hee-dae must voluntarily withdraw Supreme Court justice nomination... Re-nominate from remaining candidates" (與 “조희대, 대법관 제청 자진 철회해야…나머지 후보 중 재제청”)

Legislators from the Democratic Party of Korea on the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee argued on the 28th that Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae should withdraw his nomination of Supreme Court justice candidates. (더불어민주당 소속 국회 법제사법위원들은 28일 조희대 대법원장이 대법관 후보자 제청을 철회해야 한다고 주장했다.)

Committee Chairman Seo Young-kyo and the ruling party's floor whip on the committee, Kim Seung-won, made these remarks while meeting with reporters at a hotel in Incheon where the party's lawmakers' workshop was held that day, sharing the results of the previous day's subcommittee discussions. (법사위원장인 서영교 의원과 법사위 여당 간사인 김승원 의원은 이날 당 의원 워크숍이 열린 인천의 한 호텔에서 기자들과 만나 전날 진행된 상임위별 분임 토론 결과를 전하며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Kim said, "We reached the conclusion that before the revision of the Court Organization Act, Cho Hee-dae should voluntarily withdraw his nomination of the current candidate (which was made without consultation) and consult with the president to re-nominate from the remaining three candidates from the first round." (김 의원은 “법원조직법 개정 이전에 조희대가 협의 없이 제청한 현 후보자(에 대한 제청)를 자진 철회하고 1차에서 꾸려진 나머지 3명 후보자에 대해 대통령과 협의해 재제청하는 게 맞는다는 결론에 이르렀다”고 했다.)

Kim added, "Otherwise, we will deem it a violation of the Court Organization Act and take steps not only regarding the (committee) witness appearance on the 31st but also further actions," and "There was even discussion on whether it is necessary to specify or codify relevant provisions in the Court Organization Act." (김 의원은 “그렇지 않으면 법원조직법 위반으로 판단하고 31일 (법사위) 증인 출석뿐 아니라 다음 스텝도 밟을 예정”이라며 “필요하면 법원조직법에 (관련 조항을) 구체화 또는 명문화하는 게 필요하다는 논의까지 있었다”고 했다.)

Seo said, "When nominating Supreme Court justice candidate Son Bong-ki, there should have been sufficient consultation and consensus, but it is well known to the world that this did not happen," adding, "I hope there will be sufficient consultation and agreement on the remaining candidates and a swift re-nomination of Supreme Court justices." (서 의원은 “손봉기 대법관 후보자를 제청할 때 충분히 협의하고 합의에 이르렀어야 하는데 그렇지 못한 것은 온 세상에 알려졌다”며 “나머지 후보자를 대상으로 충분히 협의하고 합의해 빠른 대법관 재제청이 있으면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

They also stated that regarding the special counsel bill on fabricated prosecutions, they have decided to coordinate with the party leadership to determine the timing of its push. Kim said, "It is right that a special counsel should be launched to uncover the facts of fabricated prosecutions," but "the consensus was to decide the timing in consultation with the leadership." (이들은 조작 기소 특검법과 관련해선 당 지도부와 조율해 추진 시기를 결정하기로 했다고 밝혔다. 김 의원은 “조작 기소 사실을 밝히기 위한 특검 출범을 해야 하는 것은 맞는다”면서도 “그 시기는 지도부와 협의해서 정한다는 의견으로 모아졌다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Hangars replacing Gwangju vulnerable to missiles and drones ([단독] 광주 대체할 격납고, 미사일·드론 무방비)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Hangars replacing Gwangju vulnerable to missiles and drones ([단독] 광주 대체할 격납고, 미사일·드론 무방비)

The government announced a plan to temporarily disperse the capabilities and facilities of the Gwangju military airport to the Yecheon, Seosan, and Chungju military airports by mid-2028 to build a semiconductor cluster in the Honam region, but it was confirmed on the 27th that the military hangars to be built at the temporary dispersal sites have no ballistic missile protection capability. The offices where flight squadrons and maintenance company personnel will work are also known to be built as modular (prefabricated) buildings without "chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) protection functions," unlike existing facilities. <<> According to data recently received by the office of Rep. Yoo Yong-won of the People Power Party, a member of the National Assembly National Defense Committee, from the Air Force, the military plans to apply "simplified structures and construction methods" in building temporary deployment facilities at the Yecheon, Seosan, and Chungju military airports by 2028. Existing military aircraft hangars at military airports are reinforced concrete hardened shelters (掩體壕) with thick walls and roofs to withstand enemy bombardment, but the temporary deployment facilities are to be built in the form of "revetments" with steel plate structures. (정부가 호남권 반도체 클러스터 건설을 위해 광주 군공항의 전력과 시설을 2028년 중순까지 예천·서산·충주 군공항으로 임시 분산하겠다는 계획을 밝힌 가운데, 군이 임시 분산지에 지을 군용기 격납고에는 탄도미사일 방호 능력이 없는 것으로 27일 확인됐다. 비행대대와 정비중대 장병들이 근무할 사무실도 기존 시설과 달리 ‘화생방 방호 기능’이 없는 모듈러(조립식) 건물로 지어질 것으로 알려졌다.)

Although revetments also have some blast absorption capability, they are assessed as having virtually no anti-aircraft protection against missile, bomb, or drone attacks. The military described the revetment facilities as "having no protection capability" in its explanatory materials. The Air Force responded to this newspaper's inquiry, saying, "Hardened shelters have all-around protection capabilities, while revetments have only lateral protection capabilities." The Air Force also stated, "Revetments and modular buildings are easy and economical to construct and dismantle, making them suitable as temporary deployment facilities," and "we will minimize the impact on readiness posture." (국회 국방위원회 소속 국민의힘 유용원 의원실이 최근 공군으로부터 받은 자료에 따르면, 군은 2028년까지 예천·서산·충주 군공항에 임시 배치용 시설을 짓는 과정에서 ‘간이 구조 및 공법’을 적용할 방침이다. 기존 군공항의 군용기 격납고는 적의 폭격에 대비해 벽과 지붕을 두껍게 만든 철근 콘크리트 구조의 엄체호(掩體壕)지만, 임시 배치용 시설은 강철판 구조의 ‘리베트먼트(Revetment·방호벽)’ 형태로 짓겠다는 것이다.)

However, Hong Seong-pyo, a former Air Force officer and head of the Defense Policy Research Office at the Korea Military Research Institute, said, "Placing our military aircraft in hangars with virtually no protection capability is an idea that is hard to accept given the possibility that adversaries such as North Korea could strike our military airports." (리베트먼트도 일부 폭발 충격 흡수 기능은 있지만, 미사일·폭탄이나 드론 공격 등에 대한 대공 방호 기능은 사실상 없다는 평가를 받는다. 군은 설명 자료에서 리베트먼트 시설에 “방호 기능이 없다”고 표현했다. 공군은 본지 질의에 “엄체호는 전방위 방호 기능이 있고, 리베트먼트는 측면에 대한 방호 기능만 있다”고 답했다. 공군은 또 “리베트먼트와 모듈러 건물은 시설 공사와 철거가 용이하고 경제적이기 때문에 임시배치 시설로 적합”하다며 “대비태세에 미치는 영향을 최소화하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

◇Cannot even block chemical attacks… "Are they sacrificing national security for political promises?" (그러나 공군 출신인 홍성표 한국군사문제연구원 국방정책연구실장은 “방호 능력이 사실상 없는 격납고에 우리 군용기를 둔다는 것은 북한 등 적이 우리 군공항을 타격할 가능성을 고려한다면 나오기 어려운 발상”이라고 했다.)

The military announced on the 14th a "chain relocation" plan to move the capabilities of the 1st Fighter Wing currently stationed at Gwangju Military Airport to the 16th Fighter Wing in Yecheon, North Gyeongsang Province, and the 20th Fighter Wing in Seosan, South Chungcheong Province, while transferring some existing functions of the 16th Fighter Wing to the 19th Fighter Wing in Chungju. This came four days after President Lee Jae-myung ordered the Ministry of National Defense to temporarily deploy the functions of the Gwangju base to other military airports by mid-2028, saying the situation "requires not a war of speed but a war of lightning" to create the Honam semiconductor cluster. (◇생화학 공격도 못 막아… “정치적 공약 위해 안보 희생시키나”)

The final relocation destination, Muan Military Airport, is targeted for completion by the end of 2032. Ultimately, the period during which the current 1st Wing's assets in Gwangju, including T-50 advanced trainer aircraft, will use the newly built aircraft hangars at the Yecheon, Seosan, and Chungju bases is only about four years. This is reportedly why the military chose "simplified structures and construction methods." Building hardened shelters, known to cost hundreds of millions of won per unit, for temporarily deployed forces would be inefficient. (군은 현재 광주 군공항에 주둔하는 제1전투비행단 전력을 경북 예천의 제16전투비행단과 충남 서산의 제20전투비행단으로 나누어 이동시키고, 제16전투비행단의 기존 기능 일부를 충주의 제19전투비행단으로 옮긴다는 ‘연쇄 이동’ 계획을 지난 14일 발표했다. 이재명 대통령이 호남 반도체 클러스터 조성 등을 위해 “속도전을 넘어 전격전을 치러야 하는 상황”이라며 2028년 중반까지 광주 기지의 기능을 다른 군 공항으로 임시 배치해 달라고 국방부에 지시한 지 나흘 뒤의 일이었다.)

Among the assets to be relocated from Gwangju Military Airport, the T-50 accounts for the largest number at around 40 aircraft, and the fact that they are relatively low-value assets within the Air Force's inventory reportedly factored into the decision. (최종 이전 대상지인 무안 군공항의 준공은 2032년 말을 목표로 하고 있다. 결국 현재 광주 제1비행단의 T-50 고등훈련기 등 전력이 예천·서산·충주 기지에 새로 짓는 비행기 격납고를 이용하는 기간은 4년여에 불과하다. 군이 ‘간이 구조 및 공법’을 택한 것도 그 때문으로 전해졌다. 임시 배치된 전력을 위해 신축 비용이 1기당 수십억 원이 넘는 것으로 알려진 엄체호 등을 짓는 것은 비효율적이라는 것이다.)

However, a former Air Force major said, "The difference in protection levels between hardened shelters and revetments is as great as between a 'house' and a 'tent.'" Another military official said, "Revetments are open at the front and rear, so maintenance demand for fighters will also increase." In August of last year, the prominent academic journal "International Security" published a paper estimating the scale of U.S. fighter losses in a hypothetical large-scale Chinese air strike on U.S. air bases. According to the paper, if 300 additional hardened aircraft shelters (HAS) for cutting-edge aircraft were installed, the number of damaged fighters would decrease by about 30%, from 299 to 208. (광주 군 공항에서 이전될 전력 중에는 T-50이 40여 대로 가장 많은데, 상대적으로 공군 전력 중 저(低)가치 자산이라는 점도 고려된 것으로 전해졌다.)

Security experts assess that many of our Air Force's hardened shelters have protection capabilities similar to U.S. HAS. Regarding the situation where fighters previously housed in such hardened shelters must be kept in revetments for several years, Shin Jong-woo, secretary-general of the Korea Defense and Security Forum, said, "The decision to forcibly vacate Gwangju Military Airport has ultimately created a hole in our security posture." (그러나 한 공군 예비역 소령은 “엄체호와 리베트먼트의 방호 수준은 ‘집’과 ‘천막’ 수준으로 차이가 크다”고 말했다. 또 다른 군 관계자는 “리베트먼트는 앞뒤가 뚫려 있어 전투기 정비 수요도 늘 것”이라고 했다. 지난해 8월 유력 학술지 ‘국제 안보’에는 중국이 미군 비행장에 대규모 공습을 한다고 가정했을 때 피해를 볼 미군 전투기 규모를 추산한 논문이 실렸다. 이 논문에 따르면 최신예 항공기 ‘강화 격납고(HAS)’가 300곳 추가로 설치돼 있는 경우, 피해 전투기 대수는 기존 299대에서 208대로 30%가량 감소했다.)

The new facilities to be built at the three military airports serving as temporary dispersal sites reportedly also lack "CBRN protection capabilities." The facilities where the existing 1st Wing's flight squadron and maintenance company personnel work are equipped with positive pressure systems that raise internal air pressure to prevent contaminated outside air from entering in the event of an enemy chemical or biological attack. However, the offices to be built for the temporary dispersal are of a simple "modular structure" and lack such capability. Hong Seong-pyo, head of the Defense Policy Research Office at the Korea Military Research Institute, said, "In such a state, there are concerns that pilots and maintenance personnel could suffer heavy casualties from a surprise enemy chemical or biological weapons attack," adding, "If national security posture is sacrificed for political promises, it will be difficult to avoid criticism that the priorities have been reversed." (우리 공군의 엄체호 상당수는 미국의 HAS와 비슷한 수준의 방호 능력을 갖췄다는 것이 안보 전문가들의 평가다. 이런 엄체호에 있던 전투기들을 수년간 리베트먼트에 둬야 할 상황이 된 데 대해 신종우 한국국방안보포럼 사무총장은 “광주 군공항을 무리하게 비우게 한 결정이 결국 안보 태세에 구멍을 만든 셈”이라고 했다.)

Concerns are also raised that the Air Force's pilot training process could be affected. Currently, the 1st Fighter Wing in Gwangju is primarily responsible for advanced flight training to produce fighter pilots. The flight education and training conducted at Gwangju Military Airport reportedly takes a total of 14 months, combining the "advanced fighter course" and the "fighter tactical introduction course." It requires around 90 sorties and about 90 flight hours. However, if the training aircraft there have to share runways with existing military aircraft at the temporary dispersal bases, training frequency could decrease and training duration could lengthen. A former Air Force pilot said, "To maintain the pilot training timeline, a situation could arise where the sortie rates of existing fighters must be reduced," adding, "Either way, the Air Force's combat power will take a hit." (임시 분산배치 부지가 된 3곳 군공항에 새로 짓는 시설에는 ‘화생방 방호 능력’도 없는 것으로 알려졌다. 기존 제1비행단 비행대대와 정비중대 장병들이 근무하는 시설에는 적의 생화학 공격 시 내부의 기압을 높여 오염된 외부 공기의 유입을 막는 양압(陽壓) 설비가 갖춰져 있다. 하지만 임시 분산을 위해 지을 사무실은 단순한 ‘모듈러(조립식) 구조’라 이런 능력이 없다는 것이다. 홍성표 한국군사문제연구원 국방정책연구실장은 “이런 상태라면 적의 기습적인 생화학 무기 공격에 조종사와 정비 인력들이 큰 피해를 입을 우려가 있다”며 “정치적 공약을 위해 안보 태세를 희생시킨다면 본말이 전도됐다는 비판을 피하기 어려울 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: "Tiger stripes are on the outside, people's are on the inside"... Mixed interpretations of Park Geun-hye's remarks (“호랑이 줄무늬는 밖, 사람은 안”... 박근혜 발언 두고 해석 분분)
item.description:
As former President Park Geun-hye attended the People Power Party's retreat for the first time in 14 years, interpretations within the party are divided on the 28th over her "tiger stripes" remark. (국민의힘 연찬회에 박근혜 전 대통령이 14년 만에 참석한 가운데 28일 박 전 대통령의 ‘호랑이 줄무늬’ 발언을 두고 당내 해석이 엇갈리고 있다.)

In her speech at the lawmakers' retreat held the previous day at Sono Calm Hotel in Goyang, Gyeonggi Province, Park said, "There is a saying that a tiger's stripes are on the outside, but a person's stripes are on the inside," adding, "This means that while a person's appearance can be easily distinguished with the eyes, their heart or character is not outwardly revealed, so it cannot be easily known." She then emphasized "trust is the foundation of survival" (無信不立), saying, "If there is no trust within a political party, that party cannot survive." <<> Lawmakers were split in their interpretations of Park's characteristically ambiguous rhetoric. One lawmaker from the mainstream pro-party faction said, "Isn't it a message that one should not engage in politics of betrayal?" interpreting it as targeting former lawmaker Yoo Seong-min, who was an original pro-Park figure but later became politically estranged from Park. <<> On the same day, Yoo appeared on a media outlet's YouTube channel and said, "I asked lawmaker Yoo Young-ha early last year to arrange a meeting with former President Park, but got no response for over a year," adding, "If there is a chance to meet, I would earnestly ask her to help resolve the conservative division caused by the impeachment debate." In response, lawmaker Yoo Young-ha, who is close to Park, appeared on a radio program that morning and said regarding this, "People often frame it as betrayal, but whether he was a traitor or not is for the public to judge." <<> There are also criticisms that this is a wasteful dispute. The argument is whether it is appropriate to engage in "traitor" accusations within the party at a time when they should be fighting against the massive opposition party. In fact, some members of the pro-leadership faction say, "Lawmaker Han Dong-hoon is not free from the betrayal narrative either," while the pro-Han faction has been making self-serving interpretations, such as, "Isn't the real traitor Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, who was a close aide to Han and then kicked him out of the party after becoming leader?" One three-term lawmaker said, "Everyone is accusing each other of being traitors from their own perspectives," adding, "Former President Park emphasized for a long time that 'internal division is the most fearsome enemy,' yet they are still fighting." <<> Disagreements also emerged within the party over Park's emphasis on "comradeship" and unity at the retreat the previous day. Lawmaker Park Soo-young wrote on Facebook that day, citing Park's message of internal unity, "In former President Park's remarks yesterday, there is the path our party should take." Lawmaker Cho Ji-yeon also responded to Park's message, saying, "We will work harder so that our party gains the public's trust through united strength." <<> However, Lee Seong-kwon, a non-mainstream lawmaker within the party, appeared on MBC the previous day and said, "Since there is no one playing the role of an elder figure in the party, we had no choice but to invite her, but there is a somewhat dishonorable aspect to it, so the timing and venue were inappropriate," adding, "This should have been a session to discuss strategies for responding to the regular session of the National Assembly, but because former President Park was invited, all the news coverage was focused on this." <<> Kim Jong-hyuk, a former Supreme Council member classified as pro-Han, appeared on CBS Radio that day and criticized Representative Jang Dong-hyuk and the pro-leadership faction, saying, "To achieve internal unity, the leader himself must not go down the wrong path, and then he should persuade others to follow, but isn't he failing to do that?" Song Young-hoon, a former spokesperson in the pro-Han faction, also appeared on YTN that day and said regarding the invitation of Park to the retreat, "At a time when the People Power Party should move forward into the future for conservative reconstruction, I don't see it as very positive that we have once again created an occasion to summon these stories from the past." (박 전 대통령은 전날 경기 고양 소노캄 호텔에서 열린 의원 연찬회 연설에서 “호랑이 줄무늬는 밖에 있지만 사람의 줄무늬는 안에 있다는 말이 있다”며 “이건 사람의 생김새 외모는 눈으로 잘 구별할 수 있지만 사람의 마음이나 성품은 겉으로 드러나지 않기 때문에 쉽게 알 수 없다는 말”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “정당 내에서 신의가 없으면 그 정당은 존립할 수 없다”며 ‘무신불립(無信不立·신뢰 없이 설 수 없다)’을 강조했다.)

item.title: President Lee's Approval Rating Drops 3%p to 42%... Record Low (李대통령 지지율, 3%p 떨어진 42%... 역대 최저치)
item.description:
President Lee's Approval Rating Drops 3%p to 42%... Record Low (李대통령 지지율, 3%p 떨어진 42%... 역대 최저치)

A Gallup Korea poll released on the 28th showed President Lee Jae-myung's job approval rating at 42%, the lowest since taking office. Fifty percent of respondents evaluated the president's performance negatively. (이재명 대통령의 직무 수행 지지율이 42%로, 취임 후 최저치를 기록했다는 한국갤럽 여론조사 결과가 28일 공개됐다. 응답자 50%는 이 대통령 직무 수행을 부정적으로 평가했다.)

According to a survey conducted by Gallup Korea on the 25th and 26th targeting 1,001 voters nationwide, the positive evaluation of President Lee's job performance stood at 42%, down 3 percentage points (p) from the previous survey. This is the lowest figure among surveys conducted by Gallup Korea since the president took office. It is also 2%p lower than the August second-week survey (44%), which had been the lowest on record for Gallup Korea. (한국갤럽이 지난 25~26일 전국 유권자 1001명을 대상으로 실시한 조사 결과, 이 대통령 직무 수행에 대한 긍정 평가는 42%로 직전 조사 대비 3%포인트(p)가 하락했다. 이는 이 대통령 취임 후 한국갤럽이 실시한 조사 가운데 최저치다. 한국갤럽 조사 기준 최저치였던 8월 2주차 조사(44%)보다도 2%p 낮은 수치다.)

Negative evaluations rose 5%p from the previous survey to 50%, the highest since taking office. Respondents who withheld their opinion accounted for 5%. (부정 평가는 직전 조사 대비 5%p 상승한 50%로, 취임 후 가장 높게 나타났다. 의견을 유보한 응답은 5%였다.)

Negative evaluations of President Lee's job performance exceeded 50% in all regions and age groups, except for the Honam region and the 4050 generation. By region, it was 18% in South Jeolla-Gwangju and North Jeolla, while Seoul and Busan·Ulsan·South Gyeongsang posted 53%, Incheon·Gyeonggi 50%, Daegu·North Gyeongsang 63%, and Daejeon·Sejong·Chungcheong 55%. By age group, negative responses ranged from 52% to 27% across all age groups, except for those in their 40s (38%) and 50s (45%). (이 대통령 직무 수행에 대한 부정 평가는 호남 지역과 4050 세대를 제외한 전 지역, 전 연령대에서 50%이상으로 나타났다. 지역별로 보면 전남광주와 전북에서 18%였고, 그 외에 서울과 부산·울산·경남(53%), 인천·경기(50%), 대구·경북(63%), 대전·세종·충청(55%)으로 나타났다. 연령별로는 40대(38%)와 50%(45%)를 제외한 전 연령에서 52~27%의 부정 평가 반응이 나타났다.)

Respondents who negatively evaluated President Lee's performance (499 people) cited 'real estate policy' (27%) as the biggest reason. This was followed by 'reduction of prosecution powers' (7%), 'economy and livelihood' (7%), 'moral issues and evasion of one's own trial' (7%), 'overall poor performance' (5%), 'defense and security' (5%), 'dictatorship and arbitrariness' (5%), and 'lack of unity and bipartisan governance' (4%). (이 대통령 직무 수행을 부정 평가한 응답자(499명)들은 ‘부동산 정책’(27%)을 가장 큰 이유로 꼽았다. 이어 ‘검찰 권한 축소’, ‘경제·민생’, ‘도덕성 문제·본인 재판 회피’은 7%, ‘전반적으로 잘못한다’, ‘국방·안보’, ‘독재·독단’은 5%, ‘통합·협치 부족’은 4% 순이었다.)

In terms of party support, the Democratic Party of Korea recorded 39% and the People Power Party 25%. Compared to the previous week, the Democratic Party fell 2%p, while the People Power Party remained unchanged. (정당 지지도는 더불어민주당이 39%, 국민의힘이 25%를 기록했다. 지난주 대비 민주당은 2%p 내렸고, 국민의힘은 변동이 없었다.)

This survey was conducted using a computer-assisted telephone interviewing (CATI) method with wireless phone virtual numbers. The margin of sampling error is ±3.1 percentage points at the 95% confidence level, and the response rate was 9.5%. For more details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website. <<>> (이번 조사는 무선전화 가상번호를 활용한 전화조사원 인터뷰(CATI) 방식으로 진행됐다. 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에 ±3.1%포인트, 응답률은 9.5%다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지를 참조하면 된다.)

item.title: Blue House: "Decision Not to Submit Appointment Motion for Supreme Court Justice Nominee Son Bong-gi... Request for Re-nomination" (靑 “손봉기 대법관 후보자 임명동의안 제출않기로…재제청 요청”)
item.description:
The Blue House announced on the 28th that it will not submit an appointment motion to the National Assembly for nominee Son Bong-gi, who was nominated as the successor to former Supreme Court Justice Noh Tae-ak, and will instead request Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae to make a re-nomination. This marks the first time a president has rejected a nomination by the Supreme Court Chief Justice. (청와대는 28일 노태악 전 대법관의 후임으로 임명 제청된 손봉기 후보자에 대해 국회에 임명 동의안을 제출하지 않고, 조희대 대법원장에게 재(再)제청을 요청하기로 했다. 대통령이 대법원장의 제청을 거부한 것은 처음이다.)

Kang Yu-jeong, Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations, stated at a briefing at the Chun Choo Kwan, "For the first Supreme Court justice selection under a people-sovereignty government, the legitimacy of the process must be convincing to the people before considering the outcome." This implies that Chief Justice Cho's written nomination of nominee Son Bong-gi on the 18th, without prior consultation with the Blue House, violated procedural legitimacy. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 춘추관 브리핑에서 “국민 주권 정부의 첫 대법관 인선은 결과에 앞서 절차의 정당성 측면에서부터 국민께서 납득할 수 있어야 한다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 조 대법원장이 지난 18일 청와대와의 사전 협의 없이 손봉기 후보자를 서면 제청한 것은 절차적 정당성을 위반했다는 취지다.)

Secretary Kang said, "The fact that past presidents and Supreme Court chief justices have always proceeded with nominations through prior consultation was in line with the constitutional intent of mutual respect for the authority of each institution," and "The nomination for the successor to former Justice Noh Tae-ak did not sufficiently meet the standard of procedural completeness." (강 수석대변인은 “그동안 역대 대통령과 대법원장이 사전 협의를 거쳐 제청에 이르러 온 것은 각 기관간의 권한을 상호 존중하라라는 헌법의 취지에 따른 것이었다”며 “이번 노태악 전 대법관 후임자에 대한 제청은 그 절차적 완결성을 충분히 갖추지 못했다”고 했다.)

She continued, "This practice of consultation has been a procedural mechanism that prevented the highest court from being constituted by the will of only one side—either the appointer or the nominator—and has substantially supported judicial independence in the process," adding, "It is deeply regrettable that the judiciary has abandoned this practice, as it weakens the very foundation that has upheld judicial independence until now." (이어 “그동안의 협의 관행은 임명권자와 제청권자 어느 한쪽의 의사만으로 최고법원이 구성되는 일을 막고 그 과정에서 사법부의 독립을 실질적으로 뒷받침해 온 절차적 장치였다”며 “사법부가 그 관행을 저버린 것은 지금껏 사법부 독립을 지탱해 온 근거를 스스로 약화시키는 일이라는 점에서 매우 안타깝다”고 했다.)

Secretary Kang also said, "Meanwhile, it was confirmed in the National Assembly that, just before the nomination of nominee Son Bong-gi, the Court Administration Office contacted the candidates recommended by the Supreme Court Justice Nomination Committee under the Court Organization Act and sounded them out individually about the possibility of re-running the recommendation process," and "Probing individual candidates about excluding those already legitimately recommended from the nomination pool is deemed to undermine trust in the fairness of the personnel process." (강 수석대변인은 “한편 손봉기 후보자 제청 직전 법원행정처가 대법관 후보 추천위원회에서 법원조직법에 따라 추천한 후보자들에게 개별적으로 연락해 추천 절차를 다시 진행하는 방안을 타진한 사실도 국회에서 확인됐다”며 “이미 정당하게 추천된 후보자들을 제청 대상에서 배제하는 방안을 후보자 개인에게 타진한 것은 인사 절차의 공정성에 대한 신뢰를 훼손하는 일이라 판단된다”고 했다.)

Secretary Kang stated, "The Supreme Court Chief Justice's nomination authority is not a self-contained power in itself, but a power that must be exercised in a way that respects the substantive appointment authority the Constitution grants to the president as the appointer," and "The request for re-nomination is not meant to limit the Chief Justice's nomination authority, but is an unavoidable measure to ensure that nominations are made on the basis of respect for each institution, as one form of the mutual checks envisioned by the Constitution." (강 수석대변인은 “대법원장의 제청권은 그 자체로 완결적인 권한이 아니라, 헌법이 임명권자인 대통령에게 부여한 실질적 임명권을 존중하는 방향으로 행사되어야 하는 권한”이라며 “재제청 요청은 대법원장의 제청권을 제한하라는 것이 아니라 헌법이 예정한 상호 견제의 한 방식으로서 제청이 각 기관에 대한 존중의 토대 위에서 이루어지도록 하기 위한 불가피한 조치”라고 했다.)

However, the Blue House indicated that it will submit an appointment motion to the National Assembly on the same day for nominee Kim Seong-su, the successor to Justice Lee Heung-gu. <<>> (다만 청와대는 이흥구 대법관의 후임인 김성수 후보자에 대해서는 이날 국회에 임명 동의안을 제출하겠다는 방침이다.)

item.title: Democratic Party's warning "Kim Eo-jun is wrong... Pro-government media must be accurate" (민주당의 경고 “김어준 틀렸다...진영 미디어 정확해야”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea has issued an official warning to broadcaster Kim Eo-jun over his remarks suggesting that it would be difficult for the president's approval rating to rebound if it stays in the 30% range. The pro-Myung faction is strongly pushing back against claims by figures like Yoo Si-min and Kim Eo-jun, who have been citing falling approval ratings to argue that President Yoon must shift his stance toward pragmatism and expanding his base. (더불어민주당이 대통령 지지율이 30%대를 기록할 경우 반등하기 어렵다는 취지로 발언한 방송인 김어준씨에 공식 경고했다. 친명계는 최근 유시민·김어준씨 등이 지지율 하락을 근거로 실용·외연 확장을 강조해 온 이 대통령이 기조를 바꿔야 한다고 주장하는데 대해 강하게 반발하고 있다.)

Lee Yong-woo, the Democratic Party's spokesperson, said in a written briefing on the 28th, "It is inappropriate to recklessly presume public sentiment," adding that Kim Eo-jun's claims are "wrong." (이용우 민주당 대변인은 28일 서면브리핑을 통해 “민심을 함부로 예단하는 것은 부적절하다”며 김어준 씨의 주장에 대해 “틀렸다”고 밝혔다.)

Citing Gallup Korea data, the spokesperson pointed to cases where former President Kim Young-sam's approval rating rebounded from 28% to 41%, and former President Kim Dae-jung's from 38% to 54%. He also noted that former President Moon Jae-in's approval rating fell to 39% in 2019 but later rose to 71%, and after dropping to 29% late in his term, it recovered to 45% in the final survey. (이 대변인은 한국갤럽 자료를 근거로 김영삼 전 대통령의 직무 긍정률이 28%에서 41%로, 김대중 전 대통령은 38%에서 54%로 반등한 사례를 제시했다. 문재인 전 대통령 역시 2019년 지지율이 39%까지 떨어졌지만 이후 71%까지 상승했고, 임기 후반 29%까지 하락한 뒤 마지막 조사에서 45%로 회복했다고도 했다.)

"Politics is about navigating through challenges and resolving them," he said, emphasizing, "We will work as promised to turn around the approval ratings of the party and the government." He added, "Media power must be accurate. Pro-government media must be even more accurate," and "We will always correct the facts." (그러면서 “정치는 헤쳐가고 해결하는 것”이라며 “약속한 대로 노력해서 당정의 지지율을 반등시킬 것”이라고 강조했다. 이어 “언론권력은 정확해야 한다. 진영미디어는 더 정확해야 한다”며 “사실관계는 항상 바로잡겠다”고 했다.)

A ruling camp official said, "The remarks appear to reflect frustration that Kim Eo-jun and Yoo Si-min are shaking the president and the ruling camp with inaccurate analytical frameworks." (여권 관계자는 “김어준·유시민씨 등이 부정확한 분석 틀을 가지고 대통령과 여권을 흔들고 있다는 불만이 반영된 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

Earlier, Kim had said on his YouTube channel, "An approval rating in the 40% range is a psychological last line of defense," and "Looking at past presidents' approval ratings, no president who hit the 30s in the first digit has ever recovered." (앞서 김씨는 자신의 유튜브 채널에서 “40%대 지지율은 심리적 마지노선”이라며 “과거 대통령 지지율을 보면 (앞자리) 3자 찍고 회복한 대통령은 없다”고 했었다.)

Pro-Myung lawmaker Lee Hae-sik also said the previous day, "During the Kim Young-sam, Kim Dae-jung, and Park Geun-hye administrations, approval ratings that fell below 30% rebounded," adding, "Let us all join forces." (친명계 이해식 의원도 전날 “김영삼·김대중·박근혜 정부 때도 (30% 아래로 떨어졌던 지지율이) 반등했다”며 “우리 함께 힘을 모으자”고 했었다.)

On the same day, the Democratic Party announced it would expand its official YouTube channel into 'Democratic Party TV' and launch its first broadcast on the 1st of next month. Starting at 7 a.m., it overlaps with the time slot of Kim Eo-jun's YouTube channel. Inside and outside the party, this is being interpreted as a move to curb the practice of Democratic Party lawmakers relying on pro-government YouTube channels like Kim Eo-jun's, and to bring back message initiative to the party itself. (이날 민주당은 공식 유튜브 채널을 ‘민주당TV’로 확대 개편하고 다음 달 1일 첫 방송에 나선다고 밝히기도 했다. 오전 7시 시작으로 김어준 씨가 진행하는 유튜브 채널과 겹친다. 당 안팎에선 그간 민주당 의원들이 김어준씨 등 친여 유튜브 채널에 의존하는 관행에 제동을 걸고, 메시지 주도권을 당으로 가져오겠다고 선언한 것이란 해석이 나온다.)

However, Kim Nam-jun, head of the Democratic Party's public relations committee, said, "We aim to be 'Open TV,' an open content platform that encompasses both progressive and centrist camps," adding, "Rather than competing with existing excellent democratic and progressive channels, we will build a healthy and dignified public sphere ecosystem where diverse perspectives come together through solidarity and cooperation." (다만 김남준 민주당 홍보위원장은 “진보와 중도 진영을 아우르는 열린 콘텐츠 플랫폼인 ‘오픈TV’를 지향한다”며 “기존의 훌륭한 민주 진보 채널들과 경쟁하는 관계가 아니라 서로 연대하고 협력해 다양한 관점이 어우러지는 건강하고 품격 있는 공론장 생태계를 만들어 가겠다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party plans to run pilot broadcasts four times—on September 1, 3, 8, and 10—before starting regular weekday broadcasts five days a week from the 14th. (민주당은 9월 1일을 시작으로 3일과 8일, 10일까지 모두 네 차례 파일럿 방송을 진행한 뒤 14일부터 주 5일 정규 방송을 시작하는 것을 목표로 하고 있다.)
